---
title: "Part-day"
subtitle: "Two halves, with a facilitator"
---

This format takes the Europeanisation and the economy case study in a slot of three hours, with nothing to install, no account to open and nothing preregistered. You work as analyst number six on a claim of the original author (OA) that five analysts reanalysed for the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026).

## How you work

:::: {.fmt-steps}

::: {.fmt-step}
### webR {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Every task of the session is done in the browser, on the slides or in the webR workspace, whose cells run R through [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/), a version of R compiled to run inside a web page. The data are already loaded, and the cells that ask for code of your own come with hints and worked solutions, so that the session needs neither R nor an IDE on your machine.

[Open the slides](../../live/short.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
:::
